data.content_ref: inline:The hypothesis that the Collatz map is a specific instance of a provably undecidable class of functions (SRC_004) reduces to the claim that the 3n+1 constants do not constrain the map's complexity below the threshold of Turing-completeness. This relation is refuted if it is proven that the constants (3, 1) impose a structural constraint that prevents the encoding of universal computation.
